//: Which web apps must start cleanly in tools/test-apps.cjs. status: works | broken; phone/tablet override per form factor. note says what is limited. tools/smoke-apps.cjs exercises each app.

com.palm.app.calculator.note: Phone: the TouchPad calculator body fills the card (compat CSS)

com.palm.app.notes.note: Phone: one memo per row; the editor's back button shows its arrow only

com.palm.app.accounts.note: Only the released templates exist (HP webOS profile, email). New accounts cannot be signed in: no servers to validate against

com.palm.app.calendar.note: Local (profile) calendar only; no sync or reminders service. Phone: smaller headings and toolbar, one-letter weekdays in month view

com.palm.app.clock.note: Phone: clock faces scaled to fit. Alarms are stored but never ring (no activity manager)

com.palm.app.contacts.note: Phone: list and details one at a time (back gesture returns). No automatic linking of similar contacts, no photos, no vCard import/export

com.palm.app.email.note: Sample IMAP account; no mail server: sending moves the email to Sent, syncing finds nothing new. Phone: folders, list and message one at a time

org.webosphoenix.settings.note: Phoenix Settings (React, apps/settings); its launch points org.webosphoenix.settings.* share this entry

org.webosphoenix.phone.note: Phoenix Phone (React, apps/phone); tools/test-phone-messaging.cjs drives it

org.webosphoenix.messaging.note: Phoenix Messaging (React, apps/messaging); tools/test-phone-messaging.cjs drives it

org.webosphoenix.camera.note: Phoenix Camera (React, apps/camera); without a camera it shows its "No camera found" state. tools/test-media.cjs drives it with Chromium's fake camera

org.webosphoenix.photos.note: Phoenix Photos (React, apps/photos); tools/test-media.cjs drives it

org.webosphoenix.music.note: Phoenix Music (React, apps/music); tools/test-media.cjs drives it

org.webosphoenix.files.note: Phoenix Files (React, apps/files); tools/test-files.cjs drives it
